name: Cerave Blemish Control Cleanser 236ml for Blemish-Prone Skin (Made in UK)
description:
Effectively fight blemishes and blackheads with CeraVe Blemish Control Cleanser. This gentle yet powerful cleanser exfoliates dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and reduces excess oil, leaving your skin feeling refreshed, clean, and healthy.

Key Features:

Reduces Blemishes & Blackheads: Helps minimize spots and improve skin clarity.

Gentle Exfoliation: Removes dead skin cells that can clog pores.

Oil-Controlling: Absorbs excess oil and reduces shine.

Clinically Proven:

Spots reduced by up to 34%

94% agree skin feels clean and purified

80% agree visible pores look clearer

Leaves Skin Comfortable: Refreshes and maintains healthy-looking skin.

Made in UK
